Maria: Quick sync — Cypress Health asked for a 2h deep-dive workshop focused on Dedicated migration + inference tuning. Target week of Apr 10. Need facilitator + agenda + timezone-friendly slots. cc @Tara @Raj
Tara: I can facilitate the enablement. Prefer Tue/Wed afternoons PT. Will need an engineer for the hands-on model walkthrough. @Raj you good for pairing?
Raj: Yup, I can do Wed afternoon PT. I can own model/quantization topics and a demo repo. Request: need sample prompts + dataset subset 48h before.
Liam: Cypress prefers either 10:00-12:00 ET or 15:00-17:00 CET. Legal will join the first 30m. They expect hands-on labs for the latter 90m.
Maria: Proposal: split session into 30m intro/legal + 90m hands-on + 15m SRE routing. Can Tara/Raj do Wed 11:00-13:00 ET (08:00-10:00 PT)? Hits EMEA late but still possible.
Cal: I can cover routing/fallbacks — 15m near the end. Also quick note: include a slide about ded cache behavior and traffic shaping.
Raj: Works for me. I'll prepare a small repo + a short checklist. Also need a staging dev key. @calendar-bot can you open a temporary dev key request with 7d expiry?
calendar-bot: Ticket created: DEVKEY-789. Awaiting infra approval (ETA ~24h).
Tara: Quick slot poll — react with :one:/:two:/:three: if you prefer: 1) Wed 11-13 ET 2) Thu 14-16 CET 3) Tue 09-11 PT. I'll lock by EOD tomorrow.
Maria: Attendees (proposed): Cypress product lead (Anna), infra (Dmitri), legal (Marta), plus us: Maria, Tara, Raj, Cal, Liam. We'll ask Cypress to run a sample inference on their dev model before the session.
Liam: I'll send a short prework form asking for top-3 goals + sample prompts. Link: http://short.url/cypress-prework
Tara: Agenda draft:
```
- 00:00-00:30 Intro + legal Qs (ownership, data concerns)
- 00:30-01:40 Hands-on: model selection, quantization, batching, KV cache tips
- 01:40-01:55 SRE: routing, fallback & observability (Cal)
- 01:55-02:00 Next steps + followups
```
Raj: Prework checklist (short):
- share sample prompts + worst-case prompt length
- provide a small dataset snippet (10-20 items)
- confirm target latency & cost SLOs
- grant staging key or allow profiling on their staging cluster
Maria: Thanks — I'll tentatively propose Wed 11-13 ET to Cypress and note that we may pivot if legal availability conflicts. @calendar-bot please create the event once DEVKEY-789 is approved.
calendar-bot: Event created: "Cypress Enablement — Deep Dive" Wed 11:00 ET. Invite sent. Meeting link: https://meet.link/xyz
Liam: +1. I'll confirm attendees and ask them to complete the prework. If legal can't attend live, we will record first 30m.
Maria: Great work team — I'll follow up with a confirmation + attach Tara's agenda and Raj's prework checklist later today.
